newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca finance chief Mayo to join GEC.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca finance chief Mayo to join GEC.

text.p: British drug company Zeneca Group Plc said on Tuesday its finance director, John Mayo, was leaving the company to become finance director at General Electric Co Plc.
Zeneca said it named Jonathan Symonds, chairman of KPMG's global pharmaceutical group, as its new finance director, effective from October 1.
Symonds has been involved with Zeneca for the last five years. Until recently, he led the KPMG team providing worldwide services to Zeneca.

At GEC, Mayo will replace David Newlands, who quit as finance director earlier this month in a surprise move that was seen as a signal that managing director George Simpson was moving his own men into top positions.
"John (Mayo) has a well-deserved reputation as one of this country's best finance directors ... I look forward to working with him," GEC's Simpson said in a statement.
